subject: Pilot support request: Sandbox credits + trial extension for integration delay
messages:
From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@nimbusworks.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot support request: Sandbox credits + trial extension for integration delay

Hi Dev / Marissa,

Quick note from the engineering side at NimbusWorks — our SSO adapter hit an unexpected regression during this week's integration sprint. The connector is failing on token refresh for a subset of enterprise accounts (we've attached a small log excerpt). Our PM estimates it's a 10–12 business day fix to fully validate and re-run end-to-end tests.

We were planning to go live with the Redwood pilot toward the end of this month, but with the blocker we need more runway. Can Redwood provide a 4-week trial extension and a sandbox credit top-up (approximately 50k tokens) so our architects can complete validation without throttling the pilot?

We're committed to making this pilot successful — attaching the log snippet for context. Happy to jump on a call if you want a walkthrough.

Thanks,
Sam
Senior Platform Engineer | NimbusWorks
Attachments: integration_log_snippet.txt (text)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@nimbusworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Oct 2028 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot support request: Sandbox credits + trial extension for integration delay

Thanks for the details and the log, Sam — sorry to hear about the regression. We definitely want the pilot to keep moving.

Couple quick questions so we scope the ask appropriately:
- Can you confirm the earliest on-prem / staging window you can rerun end-to-end tests?
- Is the 50k tokens estimate peak usage, or total runway need?
- Any security/compliance documentation we should pre-stage while engineering finishes the fix?

Ben — tagging you to see if we can provision a short-term sandbox bump and what the approvals look like. Marissa — FYI on the SOW timing; if we extend the pilot window, we should align the MRP and deliverables.

I can also schedule a quick 30-min troubleshooting call between your engineers and our SEs today if that helps.

Best,
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Oct 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot support request: Sandbox credits + trial extension for integration delay

Looping in from sales ops — appreciate the context. Proposal from my side: provision an interim sandbox credit top-up of 25,000 tokens immediately to keep testing unthrottled, and approve a one-week extension pending engineering confirmation. If Nimbus confirms a 4-week blocking issue, I can escalate for an additional credit tranche up to 30k total, subject to manager sign-off.

Relevant constraints: our promotional policy requires a mutual action plan (MAP) for extensions longer than 2 weeks and any credit over 30k needs Director approval. I'll attach the quick policy reference for transparency.

If Marissa can sign off on the MAP terms, I can green-light the provisional 25k today.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: trial_credit_policy.pdf (pdf stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@nimbusworks.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Oct 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot support request: Sandbox credits + trial extension for integration delay

Hi Sam — thanks for the log and for flagging the impact. After reviewing the ask and Ben's note on policy, Redwood can accommodate the following to keep your pilot on track:

- 4-week trial extension (start date: 2028-10-29)
- Sandbox credit top-up: 30,000 tokens (provisional, applied today)
- Requirement: mutual action plan (MAP) capturing the integration milestones and a target fix date; we'll need the MAP signed by both teams within 7 business days of this email

I've attached a short SOW draft with the updated timeline and a DocuSign link to formalize the MAP and credit terms. Once signed, Ben will confirm the credit allocation in the console and finance will note the temporary promo.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded-sign/abc123
Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (pdf stub)

If those terms work, Sam, reply to confirm and I'll route the DocuSign. If you prefer a call, I'm available 10–11am PT today.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@nimbusworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, NimbusWorks Engineering <eng@nimbusworks.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot support request: Sandbox credits + trial extension for integration delay

Marissa / Dev / Ben — this is great, and thank you. We accept the 4-week extension and the 30,000 token top-up.

I've reviewed the SOW draft and added two small timeline tweaks in the comments. I'll click through the DocuSign link now and get the MAP back to you within 48 hours. Appreciate the fast coordination from the Redwood team — a brief SE call tomorrow morning to walk the logs would be helpful.

Thanks again,
Sam
Senior Platform Engineer | NimbusWorks
